summary: Jackson Hole is a world-class destination nestled in the Teton Valley, offering spectacular alpine scenery, world-renowned skiing, and unparalleled outdoor adventure. This premium resort town combines rugged wilderness with upscale dining and lodging, making it perfect for both adrenaline seekers and those seeking natural beauty.

restaurants.name: Snake River Grill
restaurants.description: Contemporary American cuisine with an emphasis on locally-sourced ingredients and seasonal menus. The restaurant features an extensive wine collection and elegant mountain lodge ambiance.

restaurants.name: Blue Lion
restaurants.description: Historic fine dining establishment famous for beef Wellington and romantic alpine setting. Each room offers intimate views of the surrounding mountains.

restaurants.name: Cadillac Grille
restaurants.description: Western-style steakhouse with exposed wood beams and a lively bar atmosphere. Known for generous portions and classic American fare.

restaurants.name: The Blue Dragon
restaurants.description: Authentic Thai cuisine in the heart of Jackson, offering vibrant flavors and fresh ingredients. A beloved local favorite for weeknight dinners.

restaurants.name: Snake River Brewing Company
restaurants.description: Craft brewery and restaurant with house-made beers and hearty pub food. Great atmosphere for post-adventure meals and local socializing.
restaurants.mustTry: Snake River Pale Ale with fish and chips

restaurants.name: Nora's Fish Creek Inn
restaurants.description: Cozy, hidden gem known for fresh seafood and creative preparations. The intimate setting and daily specials attract both tourists and locals.

restaurants.name: Persephone Bakery
restaurants.description: Artisanal bakery and café offering fresh pastries, excellent coffee, and homemade sandwiches. Perfect for a quick, quality breakfast or lunch.

restaurants.name: Bubba's Bar-B-Que
restaurants.description: Casual barbecue joint with authentic smoked meats and traditional sides. A favorite spot for budget-conscious visitors seeking hearty meals.
restaurants.mustTry: Pulled pork sandwich with baked beans

restaurants.name: Teton Thai
restaurants.description: Contemporary Thai restaurant with modern décor and refined flavor profiles. Popular for both casual meals and special occasions.

restaurants.name: Base Camp Bistro
restaurants.description: Mountain lodge-inspired restaurant with comfort food and outdoor patio seating. Known for warm hospitality and accessible mountain cuisine.

restaurants.name: Dornan's Chop House
restaurants.description: Ranch-inspired steakhouse in nearby Moose with stunning Teton views and premium cuts. The rustic setting enhances the authentic Western experience.

restaurants.name: Roadhouse Pizzeria
restaurants.description: Casual pizzeria featuring wood-fired ovens and creative toppings with local ingredients. A fun, family-friendly option after outdoor activities.
restaurants.mustTry: Jackson Hole pizza with grass-fed beef

activities.name: Grand Teton National Park Hiking
activities.description: World-class hiking with trails ranging from easy walks to challenging alpine scrambles. The dramatic Teton range provides stunning backdrops for all skill levels.

activities.name: Skiing at Jackson Hole Mountain Resort
activities.description: Premier ski resort with 4,139 vertical feet and terrain for all levels. Known for excellent powder, challenging runs, and modern lift infrastructure.

activities.name: Snake River Float Trip
activities.description: Scenic rafting through the Grand Canyon of the Snake River with opportunities to spot wildlife. Calm sections ideal for families, thrilling rapids for adventurers.

activities.name: Jackson Lake Kayaking
activities.description: Paddle on pristine alpine waters surrounded by the Teton range and forested shorelines. Wildlife viewing opportunities include moose, beavers, and bald eagles.

activities.name: Horseback Riding through Bridger-Teton National Forest
activities.description: Traditional mountain trail riding through wildflower meadows and coniferous forests. Multiple outfitters offer guided tours suitable for beginners to experienced riders.

activities.name: Jackson Town Square Walking Tour
activities.description: Historic stroll through the iconic plaza featuring antler arches, art galleries, and Western heritage sites. Free to explore with optional guided tour services available.

activities.name: National Museum of Wildlife Art
activities.description: World-class institution with rotating exhibitions of wildlife art spanning multiple centuries. Features outdoor sculpture trails and interactive displays.

activities.name: Jenny Lake Scenic Boat Tour
activities.description: Guided boat tour across pristine glacial lake with Cascade Canyon hiking access. Naturalist-led commentary provides insights into Teton geology and ecology.

activities.name: Wildlife Watching Safari
activities.description: Early morning or evening guided tours to spot elk, moose, bison, and bears in their natural habitat. Professional photographers lead small group expeditions.

activities.name: Teton Village Farmers Market
activities.description: Summer market featuring local produce, artisan goods, and live music in a vibrant community setting. Perfect for experiencing local culture and sourcing picnic supplies.

activities.name: Mountain Biking on Trail Creek Road
activities.description: Scenic single-track and double-track trails suitable for intermediate riders with panoramic valley views. Multiple difficulty levels available within the same trail system.

activities.name: Sunrise Yoga in Jackson Hole
activities.description: Private or group yoga classes held at scenic mountain locations or indoor studios. Sessions tailored to all levels with mountain meditation experiences.

spots.name: Oxbow Bend
spots.description: Iconic Snake River viewpoint with perfect reflections of the Teton range in calm water, especially stunning during sunrise and with fall colors.

spots.name: Jenny Lake Overlook
spots.description: Classic alpine lake photography with dramatic Teton peaks reflected in pristine glacial waters and accessible parking nearby.

spots.name: Schwabacher Landing
spots.description: Moody riverbank location with weathered driftwood and mirror-like reflections of the Tetons at sunrise.

spots.name: Mormon Row Historic Area
spots.description: Historic homestead buildings with the Teton range as dramatic backdrop, offering unique perspective combining wildlife and architectural elements.

spots.name: Phelps Lake Overlook
spots.description: High elevation vista with turquoise alpine lake and jagged peaks, requiring moderate hike but rewarding with isolation and dramatic composition.

spots.name: Jackson Town Square
spots.description: Historic plaza with iconic antler arches providing distinctive framing for street photography and cultural documentation.

spots.name: Colter Bay Marina
spots.description: Working marina with rustic charm, fishing boats, and Teton reflections ideal for dynamic water and maritime photography.

spots.name: Laurance Rockefeller Preserve
spots.description: Old-growth forest trails with dappled light, wildflowers, and intimate woodland scenes away from crowded vistas.

spots.name: Gros Ventre River Overlook
spots.description: Lesser-known viewpoint offering unique perspective of the range with autumn aspens and river dynamics.

spots.name: Chapel of the Transfiguration
spots.description: Historic wooden chapel with Teton peak framed perfectly through the altar window, creating spiritual and architectural composition.

lensRecommendations: Wide-angle 14-24mm for expansive landscape compositions and reflections
Standard 35-70mm for versatile hiking and environmental portraits
Telephoto 70-200mm for wildlife detail and distant peak compression
Macro 90-105mm for wildflower and detail work in alpine settings
photography.goldenHourNotes: Jackson Hole's high elevation and clear air create extended golden hour periods ideal for landscape photography. Summer solstice extends daylight to nearly 15 hours, while winter's short days require early preparation. Sunrise reflections on still lakes last 45-60 minutes, making timing critical for the most dramatic compositions.

weather.seasonality: Jackson Hole experiences four distinct seasons with winter dominance from December to March bringing heavy snow and cold temperatures ideal for skiing. Summer (June-August) provides warm, stable weather perfect for hiking and outdoor activities, while fall (September-October) offers mild temperatures and dramatic golden aspen colors.
weather.summary: Jackson Hole has a high-altitude mountain climate with dramatic seasonal variations. Winter brings abundant snow (perfect for skiing), while summer offers warm days and cool nights. Spring and fall are transitional periods with unpredictable weather; always pack layers.

hotels.name: Cowboy Village Resort
hotels.description: Convenient log cabin-style accommodations with kitchenettes and ski-in/ski-out winter access at mid-range pricing.

hotels.name: Snake River Lodge and Spa
hotels.description: Upscale resort combining contemporary comfort with mountain lodge aesthetics, featuring spas, restaurants, and proximity to winter and summer activities.

hotels.name: Amangani
hotels.description: Ultra-luxury destination resort perched on mountainside with panoramic Teton views, world-class spa, Michelin-starred dining, and exclusive amenities.
